trans_title: 一车行天下 第一季
introduction: Join former British special forces soldier Gary Humphrey and American gear-head Bill Wu as they attempt to drive their way out of the world's most hostile environments.Given just three days and basic survival rations, their mission is to track down a 10-year-old, 4-cylinder, four-wheel drive car, and bring it back to civilization using only their wits and their wheels. The journey pits them against the clock, the terrain, and each other...by driving where no car has gone before.
